test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 06
subject: general
question: Between which two 5-year plans, the government declared “Plan holidays”?
solution:
__
 
• The government declared **“Plan holidays” between** **3rd and 4th Five-year plans**.__
 
• “Plan holiday” occurred from **1966 to 1969**. The main reasons for the Plan holidays were the Sino-Indian War of 1962, the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965, lack of resources and increased inflation.
 
• Three annual plans were formulated during this period.
 
• The Five-Year Plan idea was aborted after this since the country faced severe budgetary deficit at the end of the Third FYP and also the borrowing from IMF touched an all-time high. 
 
• The government decided to introduce annual plans in order to focus on the short term targets.
